references.text: God's original instruction to Moses to make two golden cherubim on the mercy seat, as Exodus 37:7 describes their execution.
Describes how God would speak to Moses from between the two cherubim on the mercy seat.
Continuation of the description of how Bezalel made the cherubim, with details about their placement and appearance.
Moses heard God's voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim on the mercy seat.
Solomon made two large cherubim of olive wood for the innermost room of the temple, building upon the cherub tradition from the tabernacle.
The ark of the covenant with the cherubim was placed in the Most Holy Place in Solomon's temple.
Description of the cherubim in Solomon's temple, continuing the tradition from the tabernacle's cherubim.
Hebrews refers to the cherubim of glory that overshadowed the mercy seat, pointing back to the construction described in Exodus 37:7.
The same event described in parallel texts: the making of the two golden cherubim in the Most Holy Place.
Direct link between God's command (Ex 25) and its concrete execution (Ex 37).
Thematic parallel showing continuity in the making of golden cherubim from the tabernacle to the temple.
